samples.question: A horizontal gray beam rests on a small black fulcrum triangle. A red disk sits on the beam to the left of the fulcrum and a blue disk sits on the beam to the right. Treat each disk's weight as proportional to its area (pi times its radius squared), and its side's torque as the weight times the horizontal distance from the disk's center to the fulcrum. Which color's side has the larger torque and therefore tips down? Answer with only the color: red or blue.
